findings.source_quote: The hymn, "When All Thy Mercies O My God," written in 1712, has been published in 994 hymnals and is to this day in the list of the best 100 hymns ever written.
findings.suggested_fix:
Do not leave the hymn's English title un-translated as the sole visible title or embedded quoted prose. Either translate the hymn title into Hindi and (optionally) retain the original English in parentheses only if necessary, but prefer a full Hindi rendering for quoted substantive prose. For example: "भजन, 'तेरी सारी दयाएँ, हे मेरे परमेश्वर', जो 1712 में लिखा गया था, 994 भजन-संग्रहों में प्रकाशित हुआ है..." Update only the sentence text inside the relevant

element, preserving existing HTML tags and order.
findings.translation_quote: The hymn "When All Thy Mercies O My God" (जब तेरी सारी दयाएँ, हे मेरे परमेश्वर)†, जो 1712 में लिखा गया था, 994 भजन-संग्रहों में प्रकाशित हुआ है और आज भी सर्वोत्तम 100 भजनों की सूची में है।
